questions.name: intent
questions.instructions: What does the customer primarily want us to do? If the customer asks for money back, choose refund even when other problems are mentioned.

choices.description: The customer asks to get money back: a refund, reimbursement, chargeback, credit or compensation.
The customer wants to cancel, stop, pause or not renew a subscription or plan, or close the account.
The product, app or website is malfunctioning: errors, crashes, features not working.
The status, tracking, delay, location, address or condition of a physical delivery.
A question or problem about a charge, invoice, price, discount or payment method that does not ask for money back.
Trouble signing in: password, verification code, locked, suspended or hacked account, login email.
